# Release Integrity Checklist: Pipeline and solution skeleton

**Purpose**: Check the quality of the requirements for publish gating, idempotency and no-overwrite, same-bytes, checksums and versioning, before tasks are generated
**Created**: 2026-10-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [research.md](../research.md) · [RELEASING.md](../../../docs/RELEASING.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Publish Gating

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec list every check that must pass before anything is published (build, tests, architecture, smoke, tag guard)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified which artifacts are smoke-run and which are only built and architecture-checked, and is the risk of shipping a never-executed `win-x64` / `linux-arm64` / arm64-image artifact accepted explicitly? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions, Research R6/R8]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the condition that stops `publish` running on a PR, or after a skipped guard, stated as a requirement rather than left to implementation? [Clarity, Research R10/R12]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "publish nothing" defined for failures *inside* the publish stage (e.g. the package was pushed, then the image push failed)? The spec covers verify-stage failures, but this partial publication is only addressed by re-run. [Gap, Spec §FR-012, §US4-4]

## Idempotency & No-Overwrite

- [ ] CHK005 Is "already published" defined for each artifact type: package version present, image tag present, release present, individual asset present? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the re-run behavior specified when a previous run left a *partial* set of release assets, including the possible `SHA256SUMS` mismatch, and is the remedy (a new version, never a retag) stated? [Edge Case, Research R10]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "an existing release is reused or updated, never duplicated" (Edge Cases) consistent with "never overwrite published artifacts" (FR-017)? In other words, is it clear that "updated" means adding missing assets only? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the requirement that the `latest` image tag is never written stated for both first runs and re-runs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it a stated requirement that the pipeline never creates, moves or deletes tags, and is that requirement traceable to RELEASING.md? [Traceability, Spec §FR-018]

## Same Bytes

- [ ] CHK010 Is "the artifacts released are the ones that were tested" stated as a requirement (spec or plan) for both the executables and the image? [Gap, Spec §US3, Research R7]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the base image pin (digest) part of the requirement, so that verify and publish cannot resolve different bases? [Clarity, Research R7]

## Checksums

- [ ] CHK012 Does a single `SHA256SUMS` file satisfy "a SHA-256 checksum for each executable", and is that interpretation written down? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §US2-3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the checksum verification procedure for users specified (command, file names, `--ignore-missing`)? [Completeness, Spec §US2-5, contracts/release-outputs.md]
- [ ] CHK014 Is it stated what the checksums do *not* prove (origin/authenticity), so users are not misled? [Clarity, Research R11]

## Versioning

- [ ] CHK015 Is the mapping from tag to product version (`v0.0.N-alpha` → `0.0.N-alpha`) specified, and is it stated where that version appears (executable names, image tag, assembly version)? [Completeness, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the initial `Hoard.Core` package version specified, and is the rule that it is independent of the release version (never overridden at pack) stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, Research R6]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the behavior defined when a spec changes `Hoard.Core` but forgets to bump its version (the unchanged version is silently skipped by `--skip-duplicate`)? [Edge Case, Gap, RELEASING.md §Package versions]

## Release Notes & Audience

- [ ] CHK018 Is the source of the "working vs planned" notes specified, along with what happens if it is missing (the run fails)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Research R11]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it decided who can download an alpha (the repo is private, so packages and releases are collaborator-only), and do the docs and notes have to say so? [Ambiguity, Research R14, Backlog 001 Outcome]

## Measurability

- [ ] CHK020 Can SC-005 ("no unintended publication" for each failure case) be verified without burning a release version, and is the verification method stated for each case? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Research R10, quickstart §4/§7]
- [ ] CHK021 Can SC-003 ("no manual publishing steps") be verified given that package/image visibility may need a manual setting? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Research R14]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
